messages:
gabi: hey @runtime-team, quick small ask for the launch doc. can you run a tiny validation sweep and tag it 'mktg-mini-1723'? we need p50/p95 text-gen latency, coldstart delta, and one embed->rerank latency number.

maria: keep it minimal: fp16 control + q8 variant. cohorts: short (<=64) and long (1024+). sample set: marketing_minisafe_v1 (seed=13).

runtime-bot: job created: JOB-1723. est ETA short cohort: 3h, full: 18h.

liam: clarifying: warmup pass with 2 warmup per pod, then idle 8m for cold. will attach run tag and per-request labels.

gabi: yes both passes. also need a tiny artifact pack (2 examples per cohort/variant) we can put in the deck. non-sensitive only.

ops: we'll log metadata: run=mktg-mini-1723, variant, cohort, pass. we'll also note any fallbacks to fp16.

maria: must have a short CSV (p50/p95/cost) and a one-paragraph note about warmup method within 24h. raw traces ok to follow.

liam: starting short cohort now. will post interim CSV to #marketing when done.

gabi: amazing, thanks :thumbsup:
